deathSays.line: You wake up with dirt in your mouth and blood on your hands that isn't yours. The sky is the wrong color — not sunset-wrong, wound-wrong. Pamela Greenberg. Taxi driver. From Columbus, Ohio. That was yesterday. This is now. You have: Boot stone, Trail compass, Dispatcher's headset, Dog tags, Dead Phone. That's everything you own in this world. Haven. Twelve people. The fire is lit. They found a deer this morning. Inside out. Not eaten — unmade. Like something was trying to understand how it worked. It didn't finish.
